entries.note: The order's data reached Techlink; its Chinese name is 收到电子信息.

entries.wording: Parcel has been received and processed at original facility
entries.note: The parcel was booked in at Techlink's warehouse in China; its Chinese name is 仓库入库.

entries.wording: Parcel has been packed and is ready for outbound shipping
entries.note: Packed at the warehouse for the line abroad; its Chinese name is 包裹装箱.
The parcel left Techlink's warehouse in China.
China's export declaration, written after the parcel left the warehouse; the parcel is not held in customs.

entries.wording: Parcel is in transit to origin airport
entries.note: On the road in China from the warehouse to the airport of departure.
The flight left the airport in China.
The flight landed in the destination country, before its import clearance.
The destination partner's hub ("ORD HUB") received the parcel after the flight landed. Not the order's data, which InfoReceived gives.

entries.wording: Your shipment has arrived at sorting center
entries.note: The sorting centre in the destination country, after the flight's arrival. The code stands for any in-transit scan without a code of its own, so only this wording is mapped.

entries.wording: Your shipment has been processed at sorting center and ready for shipping
entries.note: The destination country's sorting centre has sorted the parcel for its next leg.

entries.wording: Your shipment has departed from the transit origin
entries.note: The parcel left that sorting centre for its next leg.

entries.wording: In transit, it is currently in transit to the next facility
entries.note: A move between facilities in the destination country.
